packages/evidence/src/prompt-parts.js#pr.summary: Returns a request's valid split points, or none to send it whole.
packages/evidence/src/prompt-parts.js#pr.change: Adds the safety check for splitting a prompt: if any split point is invalid, for example one leaving a blank piece, the prompt is sent whole, same text.

packages/evidence/src/prompt-parts.js#pr.summary: Splits a prompt at its split points into pieces that rejoin exactly.
packages/evidence/src/prompt-parts.js#pr.change: Adds the split itself: the prompt becomes a list of pieces that join back to the original text in order, so the model reads exactly the same words.

packages/evidence/src/prompt-parts.js#ap.summary: Builds a follow-up request: the original prompt plus added text.
packages/evidence/src/prompt-parts.js#ap.change: Adds the helper for asking again: the follow-up keeps the original's split points plus one where the original ended, so the repeated original is read from cache.

packages/evidence/src/prompt-parts.js#co.summary: Splits a rebuilt repair at the original's end, if it extends it.
packages/evidence/src/prompt-parts.js#co.change: Adds the same reuse for repairs built from scratch: split at the original's end only when the new prompt starts with the original exactly; otherwise left as it was.

packages/evidence/src/prompt-parts.js#st.summary: Holds back requests sharing an opening until the first one's reply starts.
packages/evidence/src/prompt-parts.js#st.change: Adds a queue: requests sharing a long opening wait until the first one's reply begins or its call ends, then read that opening from cache instead of rewriting it.

packages/evidence/src/prompt-parts.js#sh.summary: Fingerprints a request's instructions, answer format and opening, to group requests.
packages/evidence/src/prompt-parts.js#sh.change: Adds the grouping rule: requests share a group only when instructions, expected answer format and opening text are identical, because only then can one reuse another's cache.

packages/evidence/src/prompt.js#refutedR.summary: Builds a re-ask about a review row the challenge step refuted.
packages/evidence/src/prompt.js#refutedR.change: Now marks a split right after the long session text every re-ask repeats, so later re-asks for that stretch of session read it from cache. The text is unchanged.

packages/evidence/src/code-pass.js#share.summary: Lists the opening lines that every code check of one change shares.
packages/evidence/src/code-pass.js#share.change: Adds one definition of that shared opening: the person's instructions, a heading and the change itself. The three check builders now all use it.

packages/evidence/src/code-pass.js#cutAf.summary: Gives the split point right after the shared opening lines.
packages/evidence/src/code-pass.js#cutAf.change: Adds where to split: the length of the shared opening lines joined together, plus one for the line break that ends them.

packages/evidence/src/code-pass.js#build.summary: Builds the request that asks an agent to check one finding.
packages/evidence/src/code-pass.js#build.change: Now splits the request after the shared opening (instructions and the change), so checks of other findings on that change read it from cache. Wording is unchanged.

packages/evidence/src/code-pass.js#build.summary: Builds the one request that checks all the review's questions.
packages/evidence/src/code-pass.js#build.change: Now splits after the same opening as a finding check, so its own re-ask reads it from cache. Its different instructions keep it from sharing the finding checks' cache.

packages/evidence/src/code-pass.js#build.summary: Builds an agent request that accounts for a batch of items.
packages/evidence/src/code-pass.js#build.change: Now splits after the person's instructions and the change, which every accounting batch of that change shares, so batches after the first read that opening from cache.

packages/evidence/src/code-pass.js#recei.summary: Asks once to fix candidates whose quoted evidence failed the check.
packages/evidence/src/code-pass.js#recei.change: The repair request now keeps the original's split points plus one where the original ended, so the original text it repeats is read from cache. Text is unchanged.

packages/evidence/src/code-pass.js#verif.summary: Checks one finding with an agent; re-asks once if unusable.
packages/evidence/src/code-pass.js#verif.change: Its one follow-up now keeps the original's split points plus one at the original's end, so the repeated original is read from cache instead of paid for again.

packages/evidence/src/code-pass.js#verif.summary: Checks the review's questions in one batch, re-asking once about unusable entries.
packages/evidence/src/code-pass.js#verif.change: As with a single finding's check: its follow-up now keeps the original's split points plus one where the original ended, so the repeated text comes from cache.

packages/evidence/src/code-pass.js#accou.summary: Runs one accounting batch, re-asking once about entries it could not use.
packages/evidence/src/code-pass.js#accou.change: Its one follow-up now keeps the original's split points plus one where the original ended, so the original text it repeats is read from cache.

packages/evidence/src/code-pass.js#runCo.summary: Runs the code step: review agents, finding checks and accounting.
packages/evidence/src/code-pass.js#runCo.change: All agent requests now pass through one queue: checks sharing an opening wait for the first's reply, and requests behind them wait too. Repairs extending the original reuse its cache.

packages/evidence/src/run-review.js#rest.summary: Re-asks the reviewer about each requirement the challenge step refuted.
packages/evidence/src/run-review.js#rest.change: Its re-asks no longer go all at once: the first goes now, the rest once its reply begins, so they read the shared session text from cache.

packages/evidence/src/run-review.js#reco.summary: Re-asks about decisions the challenge step refuted on who made them.
packages/evidence/src/run-review.js#reco.change: Same change as the requirement re-asks: the first goes at once, the rest wait for its reply, then read the shared session text from cache. No test drives this wait.

packages/evidence/src/run-review.js#rean.summary: Re-asks for the agent's own words behind refuted choices not to act.
packages/evidence/src/run-review.js#rean.change: Same change as the requirement re-asks: the first goes at once, the rest wait for its reply, then read the shared session text from cache. No test drives this wait.

packages/cli/src/review-judge.js#reviewC.summary: Builds the command-line arguments for a plain Claude CLI call.
packages/cli/src/review-judge.js#reviewC.change: A request sent in pieces now also switches the CLI to structured input (one JSON message on standard input), as images already did. Other requests' arguments are unchanged.

packages/cli/src/review-judge.js#reviewA.summary: Builds the command-line arguments for a Claude CLI agent that reads code.
packages/cli/src/review-judge.js#reviewA.change: A request sent in pieces now switches the agent to structured input, so the CLI reads its prompt as one JSON message with separate pieces. Others are unchanged.

packages/cli/src/review-judge.js#imageCo.summary: Builds a message's content: the prompt's text blocks, then any images.
packages/cli/src/review-judge.js#imageCo.change: The prompt can now go as several text blocks, one per piece, only the first marked 'save up to here in the cache'. Without split points, still one block.

packages/cli/src/review-judge.js#claudeS.summary: Writes the single JSON message line sent to the CLI's input.
packages/cli/src/review-judge.js#claudeS.change: Now also used for requests sent in pieces, not only for requests with images, so the pieces and their cache mark reach the CLI.

packages/cli/src/review-judge.js#reviewT.summary: Returns each backend's call arguments, which the stored-answer key includes.
packages/cli/src/review-judge.js#reviewT.change: Now passes 'sent in pieces' through, but only to the Claude CLI's arguments. Other backends never send pieces, so their arguments and stored-answer keys stay the same.

packages/cli/src/review-judge.js#callLoc.summary: Runs one Claude CLI call: sends the prompt and reads the reply.
packages/cli/src/review-judge.js#callLoc.change: Pieces now reach the CLI as separate text blocks. Agent calls now also signal 'reply started' at their first reply line, so requests waiting on them go sooner.

packages/cli/src/review-judge.js#withTra.summary: Retries a failed call once; resends a refused split request whole, once.
packages/cli/src/review-judge.js#withTra.change: New safety net: if the provider rejects a split request as invalid, it is resent once as one piece, same text, so the added cache mark never fails a call.

packages/cli/src/review-judge.js#without.summary: Copies a request without its split points, noting why they were dropped.
packages/cli/src/review-judge.js#without.change: Adds the copy used for that resend: same text in one piece, still able to signal 'reply started', and tagged with the reason so its attempt record says why.

packages/cli/src/review-judge.js#markRes.summary: Marks an answer as one that came from a whole resend.
packages/cli/src/review-judge.js#markRes.change: Adds a private list that remembers which answers came from a resend, so later code can tell, without changing any byte of the answer itself.

packages/cli/src/review-judge.js#resentW.summary: Says whether an answer came from a whole resend.
packages/cli/src/review-judge.js#resentW.change: Adds the check the answer store uses to refuse such answers: the split request their stored key would describe did not produce them.

packages/cli/src/review-judge.js#createR.summary: Creates the function that makes each model call and records its details.
packages/cli/src/review-judge.js#createR.change: An attempt resent as one piece now records why ('refused in parts'), so the review's usage record can count those resends.

packages/cli/src/answer-cache.js#answerK.summary: Computes the key under which a model answer is stored and found.
packages/cli/src/answer-cache.js#answerK.change: A split request's key now includes the CLI's structured-input setting, not the split positions, so its old stored answer no longer matches. Every other key is unchanged.

packages/cli/src/answer-cache.js#agentAn.summary: Computes the stored-answer key for an agent request.
packages/cli/src/answer-cache.js#agentAn.change: As with the plain key: a split agent request's key now includes the structured-input setting, so it never reuses an answer stored for the unsplit form.

packages/cli/src/answer-cache.js#createA.summary: Creates the on-disk store of past model answers.
packages/cli/src/answer-cache.js#createA.change: Its save step now refuses answers got by a whole resend, since their key would claim the split request produced them. The next review simply asks again.

packages/cli/src/answer-cache.js#memoize.summary: Returns a stored answer when one exists, instead of a new call.
packages/cli/src/answer-cache.js#memoize.change: When it reuses a stored answer, it now tells the waiting queue no call was made, so the next request sharing that opening takes the lead and writes the cache.

packages/cli/src/review-budget.js#create.summary: Tracks a review's calls, limits and usage record.
packages/cli/src/review-budget.js#create.change: The usage record now counts calls sent in pieces and calls resent whole, by reason. A review with neither keeps its record exactly as before.

scripts/session-review.mjs#runSessionRev.summary: Runs one session review for assessments, stopping on serious provider errors.
scripts/session-review.mjs#runSessionRev.change: Its emergency stop no longer fires when a split request is rejected as invalid, because the transport resends it whole; the resend's own result still counts. No test covers this.

story.oneLine: Related requests' shared opening is cached by the first and read by the rest.
story.ask: Make each Sonah review cost less, in the cost release.

beforeNow.before: Each re-ask writes the shared opening again
beforeNow.now: The first writes it; the rest read it

beforeNow.before: Related requests are all sent at once
beforeNow.now: Siblings wait until the first reply begins

beforeNow.before: The prompt goes as one string
beforeNow.now: The prompt goes as blocks, first one cached

glossary.def: Long opening several requests share; ends at the first cut.
Marker on a block: cache the prompt up to here.
Saved prompt prefix, five minutes; reading costs $0.10, writing $2.50 per million.
Siblings wait until the first request's reply begins, then go.
Claude CLI input as one JSON user message with blocks.
Hash naming a stored answer: model, argv, system, prompt.
Asking again: about a refuted row, or after an unusable answer.
